faust_epic_compat.dual_sword_mastery.des: Dual sword strikes cost 1 stamina instead of 2 with default settings.
faust_epic_compat.dual_dagger_mastery.de: Dual dagger strikes cost 1 stamina instead of 2 with default settings.
One-handed weapon strikes with a shield use normal stamina: 1 instead of 2 with default settings.
faust_epic_compat.two_handed_mastery.des: Two-handed strikes cost the same stamina as one-handed strikes. Spears always use the normal cost.
faust_epic_compat.fist_mastery.descripti: Bare-handed and glove strikes cost no stamina. Separate active skill costs still apply.
